title: [AI Business Solutions] Enforce allow-listed Redirect URIs, token audiences and authorities for OAuth2 integrations
summary: Hardens OAuth2 integrations: Intercompany now builds the authority from the tenant GUID over HTTPS and validates the destination host more strictly. The Outlook REST API customer app requires an exact redirect URI match. SII Setup emits audit and telemetry signals for invalid URLs, and the SharePoint connector guidance now recommends Sites.Selected.
key_points: Intercompany connector builds the authority from the tenant GUID with HTTPS and login.microsoftonline.com instead of reading it from setup
Intercompany destination host validation is stricter
Outlook REST API redirect URI must exactly match OAuth2.GetDefaultRedirectUrl()
SharePoint connector README and tooltip now recommend Sites.Selected over Sites.ReadWrite.All
SII Setup emits security audit and telemetry when the target URL is invalid
quote: Construct authority from tenant GUID, use Https and login.microsoftonline.com
